Both peer responses correctly note that, by definition, a planet is a body that orbits a star. In our Solar System the star is the Sun, so the object that planets orbit is the Sun. While the entire Solar System (including the Sun and its planets) also orbits the center of the Milky Way galaxy, the direct orbital relationship for a planet is with its host star, not the galaxy itself.
